components.text:
A new upgrade not present in earlier versions of the mod. Effect: grants the Luck attribute, improving loot table rolls, fishing, and similar luck-based mechanics, up to +10 Luck across 5 levels.
Like Elytra and Gilded, this upgrade isn't earned through live combat or mining actions - it is trained purely through Upgrade Tomes applied at the Living Tinker Station, intended to be found as Demon Dungeon loot.
